# My Teaching Philosophy

#### Course: React Hooks: Level Up Your First Web App

## My Teaching Philosophy

In this course, I introduce every hook through a real problem it solves. For example:

- useEffect() exists because fetching data inside the render body causes an infinite loop.
- useRef() exists because some things cannot be used as states.

In other words, my teaching philosophy can be summed up as:

State the problem first. Then show the solution, i.e., hooks.

![Problem-First Learning](data:application/octet-stream;base64,)

That's how this course is structured. Next, let's explore this structure in greater depth so you know what you're getting into.
